Commentary.Commentary: The Windies side need to show much more composure and application with the bat this time around. The top order needs to take the responsibility to set the ideal foundation. The tourists will fancy themselves to make life difficult for the home side but can the hosts rise to the occasion? Join us for the final hour of the Day which promises to be thrilling.

The West Indies bowlers put in a lot of effort but the fielders were not up to the mark on numerous occasions. There were also a lot of extras provided by the bowlers which can come back to haunt them. However, Holder was extremely disciplined and he finished with figures of 29-11-42-3. Gabriel bowled his heart out to pick up 4 wickets while Bishoo also got three wickets.

Pakistan will be happy to have finished with a lead of 81 runs. The tailenders added 64 runs after the Tea break and those runs can prove to be vital for the visitors. The ball is keeping low and it will be tough work for the West Indies batsmen against a more than capable Pakistani bowling line-up. Azhar Ali was the standout batsman for the home side and scored a terrific century. However, Misbah missed out on his ton by a run but it was still a very crucial knock for the visitors.

... DAY 3, SESSION 3 ...

Jason Holder and Shannon Gabriel were the pick of the bowlers and kept on hitting consistent lines and lengths. They picked up two wickets apiece and brought the hosts back into the contest. Pakistan only lead by 17 runs and they have just three wickets left. The home side will look to clean the tail in a jiffy after the Tea break. Can the visitors' tailenders make some handy contribution with the bat to stretch the lead to something substantial? Join us in a while to find out in the final session.

Good comeback by West Indies and they will be pleased with their efforts. They bowled their hearts out and got rewarded with four wickets in the afternoon session. It all started when Azhar Ali lost his concentration just after scoring his 13th Test ton and fell to Bishoo. Misbah-ul-Haq upped the ante and played some gorgeous looking shots. Drama unfolded when he was on 99. An LBW decision was reviewed by Holder but Misbah was safe. However, the nerves got the better of him and he lost his wicket in the very next delivery.

The ball brushes the flap of his front pad and then goes back to rap him on the back thigh. The players appeal confidently and the umpire obliges. Shafiq is quick to ask for a review. Replays show that it pitched outside off, impact was in line and the ball was clipping the leg stump. So the umpire's call stays. Shafiq has to walk back to the hut. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 3!

...DAY 3, SESSION 2...

Another session that has gone in Pakistan's favour. They have kept the scoreboard ticking at a snail's pace but the good thing is that they haven't lost any more wickets. Azhar Ali and Misbah-ul-Haq adopted a defensive approach and made the West Indies bowlers toil hard. The duo have managed to see off the second new ball with ease but have only scored 54 runs in the 26 overs. The former is only six runs away from yet another century while the latter is inching towards his fifty. West Indies have tried everything with the ball but have hardly disturbed the batsmen in the morning session. The home side need to get some wickets after Lunch to stay in the contest as the visitors are getting a good grip on this game. Join us in a while for the second session.

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of Day 3 of the second Test match between West Indies and Pakistan. It has been a contest where both the sides are playing the waiting game and holding back to watch the opposite side make the mistake. The wicket is deteriorating slowly and the bowlers can expect to get more assistance from the track.
...DAY 3, SESSION 1...

Holder was the pick of the bowlers but didn't have anything to show for in the wickets column. The successful bowlers were Bishoo and Gabriel who got two and one wickets respectively. They finally got rewarded for the hard work they put in. The visitors will look to build up on the momentum tomorrow while the home side will be aiming to trigger a collapse. Join us for Day 3 at 1000 local (1400 GMT). Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Bishoo struck for the West Indies finally to send Shehzad back and after that, the hosts capitalized on it. Babar Azam and Younis Khan departed for a duck and the hosts' bowlers got their tail up. They bowled good lines and lengths which tested Misbah-ul-Haq and Azhar Ali. However, credit to the duo for seeing the tricky passage through till the end. It could be said the scoring rate of the Pakistani batsmen was slow.

A good final session for the West Indies but it is still Pakistan's day. To start with, they cleaned the lower order of the Windies in a jiffy. After that, they came out to bat and responded well. It was the 155-run opening stand  between Azhar Ali and Ahmed Shehzad that set up the tone nicely for the tourists. Azhar Ali was rock solid and showed tremendous patience to construct his innings sensibly. He is unbeaten on 81 and another century seems to be around the corner for him. Ahmed Shehzad led a charmed life and he got three reprieves. He cashed on it and scored a fifty.

Very close! Tossed up around off, Shehzad uses his feet and drives it on the up towards Holder at short cover. He puts his right hand out but the ball goes past him in a flash. He could have converted it into a catch. Two runs taken.
This one is closer to off stump but not close enough to make Shehzad play.
Slow turn from outside off, left alone.
Ali camps back to the good length delivery and turns it towards short mid-wicket.
Shehzad shuffles a touch and works it to fine leg for a single. A run has come after 21 balls.
Length delivery angling in, Ahmed stays back and defends it solidly.
Slower delivery outside off, Ahmed strides forward and pats it to covers. Shane Dowrich walks across to the young pace bowler and has a piece of advice for him.
Short of a length outside off, Shehzad camps back and punches it to short cover.
Fullish delivery outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Slow through the air around off, defended gently towards first slip.
Tossed up around the pads, nudged to short fine leg.
Ali plays this one against the spin to the leg side.
Fullish on leg stump, Ali defends it with his bat and pad close together.
Spinning away from Ali who taps it towards point.
Camps back to the flatter delivery and works it to mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery around off, Ahmed lunges forward and pushes it back to the bowler. Pakistan trail by 180 runs.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
This one stays very low outside off, Shehzad somehow manages to defend it down the track.
Length delivery outside off, Ahmed stays back and defends it solidly.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to extra cover.
Fuller length ball outside off, Shehzad pushes at it tentatively and gets an inside edge onto his pad.
Tossed up on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed  up on leg stump, defended solidly off the front foot.
Another one that spins from outside leg and Azhar pads it away.
Full and outside leg, padded with ease.
Shortish outside off, placed through point for a single.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Ahmed sweeps it towards fine leg. Good game awareness as the batsmen run hard and complete the two with ease.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven hard to short cover who fumbles and concedes two run. Good running between the wickets.

In the air... but safe! Fullish on middle and leg, Ali looks to turn it across but is early into his stroke. Ends up chipping it towards short mid-wicket. Brathwaite dives to his left but the ball eludes him.
Well bowled! Hurls in a yorker around off, Ali digs it out and the ball goes onto deflect on his body. Falls down safely and dies down on the pitch.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Ali plants his front foot across and lets it go.
Full length ball on off, driven sweetly to mid on.
On a length on off, Ali camps back and defends it down the track.
Shehzad takes a couple of steps down the track and defends it to the off side.
Tossed up outside off, blocked to covers. The replays show that Bishoo had overstepped and the umpire failed to pick it up.
Another one outside off, Shehzad leaves it alone.
Flatter delivery outside off, Ahmed covers his stumps and allows it through.
Fullish on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Shehzad taps it with the turn towards point.
Jason Holder gets some taping on his middle finger.
Sprays this one down the leg side, Ali looks to glance it but misses.
Good shot! Back of a length outside off, Azhar punches it in the gap through covers. Two runs taken.
On a length outside off, pushed off the back foot to covers.
Shortish delivery and straight, pulled through square leg and Ali will pick up two runs.
On a length on middle and leg, nudged round the corner for a single.
The physio is treating Shannon Gabriel at the boundary line who is having a problem with his shoulder.
Angles this one from a length outside off, Shehzad looks to play it across but is rapped on the pads. No such appeal for an LBW as it was always heading down leg.
Alzarri Joseph is called back for a bowl.
Tossed up around off, eased to long off for a run and Shehzad will retain strike.
Loopy ball outside off, placed through point for two runs.
Slow away turn from around off, left alone.
Quicker and flatter delivery on off, Shehzad pats it with an angled bat to cover-point.
Stays back to this one and taps it to covers.
Ali clears his front leg and eases it to mid off for a brisk single.
Tossed up outside off, driven to extra cover.
Ahmed uses his feet and eases this one to mid off.
4th Test fifty for Ahmed Shehzad!
Fifty! Shehzad has been lucky till now but credit needs to be given to him for scoring a fifty. Spinning in towards his pads, he nudges it past the keeper and towards fine leg for a couple.
FOUR! Well played! Shortish on off, spinning away. Shehzad rocks back and cuts it behind point to find the fence.
Drifting in towards Shehzad. He camps back and defends it.
Fullish delivery around off, milked down to long on for a single.
Just short! Short delivery outside off, Shehzad pulls it towards short mid-wicket uppishly. It falls just in front of Chase who crouches and gets his body behind to stop it.
Spinning away from around off, cut to the left of the fielder at point who somehow manages to cut it off.
Tossed up on off, spinning away sharply. Pushed to the covers.
Shehzad rocks back and cuts it to point once again.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat
Shortish outside off, cut to point.
Floated outside off, driven through extra cover for a run.
Fullish delivery, eased to mid on.
Shehzad turns this with the spin to mid-wicket.
Tossed up delivery, pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Shot! Short and wide outside off, Ahmed cuts it through point to earn himself a boundary.

Not out! West Indies lose a review! Tossed up outside off, spins in sharply. Shehzad prods forward and looks to defend it but misses. Gets pinged on the front pad and the ball lobs to short leg who grabs it. The hosts go up in a confident appeal but the umpire stays unmoved. Holder has a chat with his players and decides to take the review. The replays roll in and they first show that there is no inside edge on that one. Time for the Hawk Eye. It shows the ball to be spinning down leg. Shehzad is safe.
Jason Holder takes a review against Ahmed Shehzad. It is regarding an LBW decision and also a catch appeal.
Roston Chase to continue his spell.
Another one outside leg and Ali pads it away easily.
Fullish on leg, flicked to mid-wicket. Not sure whether this ploy of bowling outside leg is going to work.
Landed outside leg, Ali pads it away.
Shorter in length, worked against the spin to mid-wicket.
Quicker and flatter this time. Spinning in from outside leg. Defended tentatively off the front foot.
Tossed up outside leg, spinning in. Nudged to the man at short fine leg.

The players are back out in the middle for the final session of the second day's play. Azhar Ali and Ahmed Shehzad will continue with the bat for Pakistan. Devendra Bishoo will start the proceedings with the ball for West Indies after Tea.
...DAY 2, SESSION 3...

Holder bowled tight lines and lengths and was the pick of the bowlers. The spinners, Bishoo and Chase got the ball to grip and turn but it was rather slow. Azhar Ali has been his usual self, batted patiently and has gone past his 26th Test fifty. The Pakistani batsmen will look to press on the accelerator and put more pressure on the hosts from hereon. It seems unlikely that the home side will trigger a collapse but stranger things have happened in cricket. Join us for the final session of Day 2 in a while.

Plenty of drama in this session but Pakistan have managed to go back to their dressing room unscathed. Both the openers, Azhar Ali and Ahmed Shehzad adopted a defensive approach. Shehzad is rather really lucky to be still out there and has got two reprieves. He was deceived twice, once by Gabriel and once by Chase. To the horror of the hosts, on both occasions they overstepped. The West Indians lacked energy in the field as well and allowed the Pakistanis to settle in.
Another one way down the leg side, Shehzad is in no mood to play those. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 2!
Sprayed down the leg side, Shehzad lets it through.
Shehzad dances down the track and ends up digging it out towards the mid-wicket fielder.
FOUR! Good shot! Floats it outside off, Shehzad charges down the track and slams it down the ground for a boundary.
Shehzad gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Ali drives it through covers for a single.
Flatter delivery outside off, Shehzad plays it late past the first slip and jogs across for two runs.
Turning away from around off, Ahmed lets it go through.
Tossed up around off, Shehzad prods forward to defend but is beaten by the sharp away turn again.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Slow through the air around off, Shehzad prods forward to defend it but is beaten by the away spin.
Tossed up outside off, driven through extra cover for a brace.
Ali gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it nicely.
Ali clips it towards the mid-wicket region.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Three leg byes! Fuller into the pads, Shehzad fails to clip it through. Gets hit on the pads and the ball rolls away past the keeper. The fielder from short fine leg puts in a dive but he cannot stop it. Stands up again and chases the ball to save the boundary with his feet. Ends up saving a run for his team.
Shehzad lunges to the pitch of the ball and drives it towards mid on.
Spinning away from outside leg, Shehzad pads it away.

NOT OUT! What has Chase done here? Sees Shehzad charging down the track, intelligently fires it down the leg side. Shehzad fails to make contact and the ball goes through to the keeper. Dowrich collects it well and dislodges the bails. Shehzad is disappointed as he is walking back. However, the umpire asks him to wait as he goes upstairs to check for the no ball. Replays show that Chase has committed the same crime Gabriel did. He has overstepped and West Indies have been denied another wicket. He has bowled the first no ball of his career and surely this is not the time he would have liked to bowl it. Shehzad is leading a charmed life.
Spinning away from around off, Ali makes a brave leave.
Ali wrists it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.

The umpires are once again having a look at the ball. Once again the rings come out. The seam has gone out of shape. Out comes the fourth umpire with a box full of balls. The cherry is being replaced with another one.
Short outside off, Ali cuts it towards the fielder at point.
26th Test fifty for Azhar Ali.

FOUR! What a way to get to his fifty! Tossed up outside off, Ali sweeps it through the square leg region for a boundary. Azhar Ali has been really patient throughout his innings and he is now getting rewarded for it.
Floats it outside off, Shehzad dances down the track and makes it a low full toss. Whips it towards mid-wicket where Chase misfields and the batsmen scamper across for a single.
Floated outside off, Shehzad reaches to the ball and blocks it away.
Into the pads, Ali defends it on the leg side.
Sprayed quicker down the leg side, Ali lets it through.
Ali lunges forward and presents the ball with the full face of his bat.
Short and outside off, Ali punches it through covers for a couple.
Ali gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Ali stays in his crease and defends it towards the fielder at point.
Floats it way outside off, Shehzad lets it through to the keeper.
Ali gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it towards long off for a single.
Spinning in from outside leg, Ali misses his clip. Gets rapped on the pads and the players appeal. The umpire stays put as it was pitched outside leg.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Floats this one way down the leg side, Ali goes for the sweep and guides it really fine past the keeper for a boundary.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Sprayed down the leg side, Ali fails to clip it fine down the leg side. Gets rapped on the pads.
Short and spinning into Ali. He shapes to pull it but mistimes it just wide of the fielder at square leg who dives to his left but the ball just goes past him. Gets a single for it.
Ali stays in the crease and defends it.
FOUR! Aggression from Ali! Chase tosses this one outside off, Ali slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Another one into the pads, Ali camps back and works it towards the fielder at square leg.
Ali stays deep in the crease and defends it.

In the air....but fell short! Spinning in from outside off, Ali tries to clip it towards square leg but is early into the stroke. Gets a leading edge to it and the ball flies back towards the bowler. Chase reacts really late and sees it falling just short of him.
FOUR! A rare boundary for Shehzad! Tossed up around leg, Shehzad reaches to it and drives it down the ground. Beats the fielder at mid on and races away to the fence.
Shehzad dances down the track to negotiate the spin. Ends up blocking it.
Floats this one around off, Shehzad drives it through the extra cover region for a couple.
Quicker through the air, outside off. Shehzad prods forward and defends it.
Short and wide outside off, Shehzad cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Floated around off, Shehzad lunges forward in defence.
Fuller into the pads, Ali digs it out towards the fielder at square leg.
Shehzad clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Floated outside off, Azhar sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Short outside off, Ali punches it towards the mid-wicket fielder off the back foot.
Fuller into the stumps, Ali clips it towards mid-wicket.
Angling into the pads, Azhar clips it through the area in front of square leg. The batsmen run a couple.
Roston Chase is back on.
Floated in the line of the stumps, Shehzad lunges forward in defence.
Shehzad dances down the track and blocks the ball away.
Ali clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Ali prods forward in defence. Gets beaten by the away spin.
Shehzad eases it towards long off for a single.
Tosses up a fuller ball outside off, Shehzad drives it back to the bowler.
Fuller into the pads, Ali clips it towards the fielder at mid on.
Ali gets behind the line of the ball and defends it on the off side.
Another delivery on a good length outside off, Ali covers his stumps and makes a brave leave.
Ali prods forward and defends the fuller length delivery.
Fullish delivery outside off, Ali shoulders his arms to it.
FOUR! Finally some runs! Angling into the pads, Ali clips it through the square leg region for a boundary.
Spinning away from around off, Shehzad prods forward in defence. But he gets beaten by the away turn.

Fuller delivery outside off, Shehzad drives it towards covers. Ali calls for a single and is halfway down the track. Shehzad sends him back really late but the fielder realises it late so Ali is safe.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Floated outside off, Shehzad stays behind the line of the ball and defends it.
Shehzad stays in his crease and drives it back to the bowler.
Tossed up around off, Shehzad defends it towards the fielder at point.
Devendra Bishoo is called into the attack. Can he provide the much-needed breakthrough?
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Ali drives it straight to the fielder at mid on.
Good length delivery around off, Ali punches it towards the fielder at cover-point.
Another one pitched outside off, Ali stays undisturbed.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Ali clips it towards mid-wicket. Chase dives to his left to stop a certain boundary.
Length delivery outside off, Ali stays behind the line of the delivery to defend it on the off side.
Angling into the stumps, Ali stays in his crease and defends it nicely.
Another short delivery outside off, Azhar sways away from the line of it.
Another good length delivery outside off, Shehzad shoulders his arms to it.
Good length delivery outside off, Shehzad defends it on the off side.
Angling into the stumps, Shehzad clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Fuller delivery outside off, Shehzad drives it towards the fielder at mid on.
Good length delivery outside off, Shehzad shuffles across and lets it through to the keeper.
Drinks time.
Good length ball outside off, Ali points his bat skywards and allows it through.
Back of a length ball outside off, keeps really low. Ali camps back, looks to defend it but gets foxed by the variable bounce.
In the channel outside off, holds its line. Ali doesn't flirt with it.
Stays back to the good length delivery and blocks it.
That's a peach! Bowls a back of a length ball outside off, shapes away after pitching. Ali feels for it but is beaten all ends up.
Good length ball on middle and leg, tucked to mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery, driven to mid on.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Not out and a no ball! Oh my word! What have you done Gabriel! Length ball outside off, angling in sharply. Shehzad looks to drive it down the ground but is hit on the pads. It looks quite adjacent and the umpire rules it out. Shehzad walks across to Ali and thinks about the review. Opts to go for it. Time for the replays. The third umpire checks for the no ball. Alas, Gabriel has just overstepped. Gotta feel for him. He deserved this wicket but the no ball issue has come back to haunt him. The Hawk Eye shows that it would have hit the middle stump but it is not of any use now. Shehzad gets lucky.
Ahmed Shehzad has taken a review against an LBW decision. Looks very close to the naked eye.
Gabriel runs in hard and bowls it on a good length outside off, gets good lift on this. Shehzad lets it through.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Shehzad leans into it and creams it through cover-point. Finds the gap and comes back for two runs.
Fuller length ball outside off, Shehzad puts hid head down and defends it calmly to covers.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Ali tucks it through the vacant mid-wicket region. Good running between the wickets by the batsmen allows them to come back for three runs.
Dug in short outside off, Ahmed shapes for the pull shot but bails out of it as it was too high.
Shehzad turns the length delivery to mid-wicket.
Length delivery around off, Shehzad goes for a drive on the up but mistimes it completely to covers.
The umpires are having a look at the ball. They are passing it through a 8-shaped gauge. The ball has gone out of shape and it is being replaced with a different ball.
Back of a length ball on middle, defended solidly off the back foot.
On a length this time, Shehzad covers the line and defends it.

A loud appeal from Holder turned down! On a good length and angling into Shehzad. He looks to play it across but is hit on the thigh pad. Holder is the only one appealing for an LBW but the umpire is not interested. The replays show there was a little inside edge on it and it was also quite high.
Jason Holder is called back.
In the channel outside off, Ali points his bat skywards and leaves it again. Every ball in this over was left alone.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
No ball! Good length ball in the channel outside off, Azhar is no mood to flirt with that one. Gabriel oversteps once again, the fifth time he has done in this innings.
Full delivery well outside off, Azhar points his bat skywards and lets it through.
Length delivery outside off, Ali doesn't fiddle with it. Third leave in a row.
Well bowled! Bowls in the corridor of uncertainty. This is on an area where the batsman is unsure of whether to be on the front foot or back foot. However, Ali makes a good leave.
Good length delivery outside off, Ali leaves it alone.
Fullish delivery outside off, defended solidly down the track.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Half-volley outside off, Shehzad eases it to mid off. He has been very slow in his innings so far. The lose deliveries need to be put away or he will not get any sort of momentum.
On a length on off, Ahmed  works it to mid-wicket.
In the channel outside off, Ahmed covers his stumps and lets it through.
Angling in from a fuller length on off, Shehzad defends it to mid on.
Fuller length ball outside off, driven to mid off.

FOUR! Edged but safe! Fuller length ball outside off inviting Ali to go for an audacious stroke. He throws his bat at it but gets a thick outside edge that flies past the left side of the diving gully fielder. Ali gets a boundary to his name but this is good bowling. The hosts need to keep on inducing false shots from the Pakistani batsmen.
Good length ball well outside off, Azhar leans towards it but doesn't fiddle with that one.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Azhar leans into it and pats it to covers.
Back of a length outside off, this time Ali punches it off his back foot to short cover.
Short and very wide outside, punched off the back foot to cover-point.
Fullish delivery on off, driven towards mid on where it is stopped with a dive by the fielder.
On a length outside off, nipping in. Shehzad plants his front foot across and  lets it go.
Fuller length ball outside off, Shehzad lunges forward in defense.
Shortish and angling into Ahmed. He mistimes his pull to mid-wicket.
Short and width on offer, Shehzad shapes for the cut but bails out of it.
Back of a length on middle and leg, tucked through in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Full and straying on the pads, clipped through square leg. Bishoo hares after it and keeps it down to a couple. End of a long over.
No ball! Back of a length delivery outside off, tapped towards point. Oh my word! Gabriel oversteps once again and this time by a bigger margin.

No ball! Bangs this one short and it's angling down leg. Shehzad ducks under it. Gabriel oversteps once again and that too by a big margin. It has haunted him in the past and the problem continues to persist.
Fuller length ball outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Short of a length on middle, tucked through backward square leg for a single.

Shortish and outside off, Ali punches it towards Roston Chase at short cover. He dives to his left and makes a good half-stop to save certain runs for his side. Ali intended to play it much squarer but the wicket is a bit slow.
Length delivery angling in, Ali covers the line and defends it a bit tentatively. His top hand comes off from the handle while playing that.
On a driving length outside off, Ali leans forward and strokes it nicely to extra cover.
Full length ball outside off, driven crisply to mid off.
Shehzad covers the line to the length delivery and defends it stoutly.
Back of a length and it's climbing up on Ali. He rises on his toes and tucks it through square leg for a run.
In the channel outside off, Azhar doesn't fiddle with it.
Back of a length outside off, Ali was expecting another one to shoot off but this one keeps a touch low. Pulled with ease through square leg for two runs.

That's a ripper! Joseph bends his back and bowls a really well-directed bouncer, Ali has to sway away from the length of the delivery to evade it. Falls off in the process. This is more like the stuff the West Indian bowlers shall be aiming to do on a more consistent basis.
Short of a length outside off, Shehzad goes for the cut once again but gets a bottom edge just beside him on the track.
Shehzad keeps his head down to the full length ball on off and defends it calmly.
Fullish delivery on off, Shehzad moves across a bit and pushes it to mid on.
Shortish and room on offer, Shehzad goes for the cut but the ball stays low. Passes under his bat and to the keeper.
In the channel outside off, holding its line. Ahmed plants his front foot across and allows it through.
Full length ball outside off, driven to mid off. He is not quite happy with the way he played that. He is practicing it now.
Shannon Gabriel to continue his spell.
Straying on the hips, tucked neatly down to fine leg for a run and Shehzad will retain the strike.
Fullish delivery outside off, defended off the front foot to covers.
Fuller length ball in line of the stumps, clipped to mid-wicket.

Ooh... that missed the off pole by a whisker! Bowls it on a good length outside off, shapes in appreciably. Ahmed points his bat skywards and leaves it alone. The ball just whizzes past his outside edge. There was completely an error in judgement.
On a length shaping in from outside off, Shehzad shuffles across and defends it down the track.
Starts off with a back of a length delivery on middle and leg, tucked nicely through backward square leg for a single.
We are back for the second session. Azhar Ali and Ahmed Shehzad will continue their innings. Alzarri Joseph to start the proceedings after Lunch. Here we go...
...DAY 2, SESSION 2...

Pakistan have dominated the first session of play. They came all charged up with the relatively new second cherry and struck quite early. West Indies only managed to add up 26 runs to their overnight score. Then the visitors stepped out with the bat. Azhar Ali and Ahmed Shehzad negotiated the new ball with ease and only had one real scare when the latter was dropped by Vishaul Singh on 3. The hosts have lacked the intensity with the ball and there is a bit of concern regarding Shannon Gabriel's shoulder. The physio was seen attending him near the fence. The home side will hope that it does not turn out to be anything major.  The West Indian bowlers will need to come back hard in the post-lunch session. Join us in a while.
Full outside off, driven to mid off. End of a maiden. THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 2!
This one shapes in appreciably from outside off, Shehzad covers his stumps and sees it through safely.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Length delivery outside off, Shehzad defends it off the inner half beside the pitch on the leg side.
On a length outside off, stays very low. Shehzad allows it through.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Shehzad plants his front foot across and allows it through.
Shannon Gabriel comes into the attack.
Quicker one outside off, Azhar stays deep in his crease and defends it to short cover.
Full toss outside off, Azhar pushes it straight to the man at short mid-wicket. The Pakistani openers need to capitalize on the loose deliveries at least.
Floated around off, flicked with the spin to mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, defended down the track.
Stays back to the shortish delivery and defends it to the off side.
Full delivery outside off, Ali pushes it towards the bowler.
Angles this one from a fuller length, Ahmed shuffles a touch and defends it to mid on.
Stays back to the good length delivery around off and defends it calmly.
Back of a length outside off, Shehzad plays it with an angled bat to gully.
Fuller one on middle and leg, clipped to square leg.
Short of a length outside off, Ahmed camps back and blocks it stoutly.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven to mid off.
Full and on middle and leg, clipped to deep square leg for a couple.
Floated outside off, turned to mid on.
On a length outside off, shoots through the pitch. Azhar was shaping for the cut but has to defend it at the last moment.
Ali covers his stumps and lets it go through safely.
Full on middle and leg, wristed through mid-wicket for a couple.
Tossed up outside off, Ali reaches out to it and blocks it.
In the channel outside off, holding its line after landing. Ahmed makes a good leave.
Good length ball, Shehzad covers the line and defends it.
Fullish delivery around off, Shehzad covers the line and blocks it nicely.
Fuller length ball on off, clipped to mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, defended solidly off the back foot.
On a length on off, Ali is squared up a touch as he taps it beside the pitch on the off side. Holder rushes towards the ball as the batsmen go for the single. It is safely taken in the end.
Flighted ball outside off, Ahmed lunges forward and defends it nicely.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floated on off, pushed to mid on.
Tossed up outside off, defended solidly to covers.
Ali clips this fullish delivery to mid on and takes off. Good judgment and he reaches to the other end safely.
It is a going to be a tough day for Dowrich. This one again takes off from one of the footmarks outside off, Ali shuffles across and leaves it alone. Shane gets up on his toes to handle it.
That's a peach! On a good length outside off, straightens a touch after landing. Shehzad shuffles across and pushes at it tentatively but gets beaten all ends up.
Stays back to the good length delivery and blocks it down the track.
Fullish delivery outside off, pushed to mid off.
Shehzad shuffles across to the fuller length delivery and defends it to mid-wicket.

Back of a length ball on middle and leg, tucked to square leg for a run.
Jason Holder introduces himself into the attack.
Close shave! Tossed up on off, Shehzad lunges forward to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball flies past the short leg fielder who didn't have any time to react. Single taken.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Works this one easily with the spin to deep backward square leg for a run.
Spinning into Ali. He stays back and turns it to short mid-wicket.
Shehzad camps back and turns it to the leg side for a single.

Two Byes! Ooh.. that took off completely! Lands this one on of the footmarks outside off, Shehzad shuffles across and lets it go. The ball shoots off and the keeper has to take evasive action. The ball bounces over him and rolls towards third man. Two byes taken.
Roston Chase to roll his arm with the ball.
Well bowled! Joseph goes wider of the crease and angles it in appreciably from a length. Ali covers his stumps and leaves it alone.
In the corridor of uncertainty, shapes in. Ali plants his front foot across and allows it through.

Good fielding, Bishoo! On a length on middle and leg, Ali works it through square leg and the ball rolls towards the deep. Bishoo hares after it from mid-wicket, puts in the slide and keeps it down to two.
On a length and shaping in, Ali shuffles a touch and defends it to mid on.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Straying on the hips, Ali rides the bounce and tucks it through backward square leg to earn himself another boundary.
Back of a length on middle and leg, turned through in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Nipping in from a fuller length outside off, Ahmed prods forward to defend it but gets an inside edge to mid-wicket. Single taken.
No ball! Back of a length ball angling in from outside off, Shehzad hops back and defends it solidly. Gabriel oversteps for the second time and he will need to load it back.
Fuller length ball outside off, Ahmed puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Fullish outside off, drive sweetly to short cover.
Short mid-wicket in place now.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Put away with ease! Short and width on offer, Shehzad cuts it with authority through covers to find the fence.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Shehzad drives it to mid off.
Angles in appreciably on off, Ali shuffles a touch and defends it to mid on.
Brave leave! Pitches this one on a good length outside off, Azhar covers his off stump and sees it through. That was not far from the off pole but Ali judged it well.
This time Ali stays back to the length delivery and pushes it to mid on.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven to short extra cover.
This time it's on a driving length outside off, Ali doesn't fiddle with it.
In the corridor of uncertainty, shapes in. Ali lets it go.
Fullish outside off again, Shehzad does not flirt with it.
Full length ball outside off, Ahmed resists the temptation to go for the drive.

FOUR! Elegant! Fuller length ball on off, Shehzad strokes it down the ground and through mid off. The timing is great on that one and the ball races to the fence. Gabriel also overstepped on that occasion.
In the channel outside off, left alone.

Dropped! Fuller length ball on middle and leg, Ahmed looks to clip it through but is a bit early into his stroke. Ends up getting a leading edge that spoons towards mid on. Vishaul Singh is a bit late to react. Runs in, dives in front, gets both his hands underneath. But the ball bounces after hitting his hands as he cannot grab it cleanly. How costly will that prove to be for the home side?
Very full delivery attacking the base of off stump, Shehzad digs it out on the off side.
Full length delivery outside off, driven crisply to the fielder at mid off.
Fullish delivery angling onto Shehzad. He pushes it towards Bishoo who misfields and concedes the single.
On a length outside off, shapes back in. Ahmed covers his stumps and sees it through carefully.
Fullish delivery outside off, Ahmed drives it nicely through the covers. Two runs taken.
On a good length outside off, swinging away. Shehzad points his bat skywards and allows it through.
Another good length delivery outside off, Shehzad lets it through to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, Shehzad shoulders his arms to it.
Alzarri Joseph will share the new ball with Shannon Gabriel.
Another full ball outside off, Ali drives it through the cover region to get off the mark with a couple.
Length delivery and nipping away, Azhar Ali tries to defend it in the line of the stumps but he gets beaten by the away movement.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
Length delivery and nipping away but pitched outside off, Azhar Ali is undisturbed by the line of the ball.
Yorker right on the money, Azhar Ali manages to dig it out just in time.
Good length delivery to start with, the ball nips in a bit. Ali stays in his crease and lets it through.
